title: Glossary Validation Report
description: 09_final_validation's output. Same shape as the sibling TOC pack's toc_validation_report.schema.json, applied to a batch's assembled path_glossary_bundle.json files instead of a single toc.json.

checks.description: One boolean per deterministic check run: schema conformance for every path_glossary_bundle.json, zero prerequisite_leakage_count, every media segment's URLs derive from its video_id and start, no overlapping segments in a group, every required fact taught by a teaching block, no path_id in the batch is missing its bundle.
